evals.prompt: Finish branch feature/000020-030-docs-runtime-fit-wording-polish with --mode local-merge into feature/improve-skill-20260618-001 for task 000020-030-docs-runtime-fit-wording-polish.
evals.expected_output: Validates the feature branch, base branch, and task directory first. In local-merge mode it does not create a PR or wait for CI. It checks out the base branch, pulls it, runs `git merge --no-ff feature/000020-030-docs-runtime-fit-wording-polish -m "Merge branch 'feature/000020-030-docs-runtime-fit-wording-polish'"`, pushes the base branch, deletes the local feature branch, verifies the merge commit subject, marks the task complete, verifies the move or empty marker commit, and returns DONE.

evals.prompt: Finish the branch in normal-pr mode after CI is green but the PR is behind the base branch.
evals.expected_output: Runs the merge-readiness gate instead of assuming green CI is sufficient. If the branch is merely behind, merges the base into the feature branch, pushes, re-verifies CI and bot review, then checks merge readiness again before `gh pr merge --delete-branch`. It does not rebase or force-push.

evals.prompt: The task is merged locally but the task directory is still under tasks/. Finish branch can skip Mark Task Complete, right?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to declare DONE. Mark Task Complete is mandatory for normal-pr and local-merge modes. It moves the task directory to tasks/completed or creates the empty marker commit when tasks/ is gitignored, verifies the completed directory and marker commit subject, and only then reports DONE.

evals.prompt: Finish branch feature/000001-010-db-create-users in normal-pr mode for task 000001-010-db-create-users with --pr-lang zh.
evals.expected_output: Builds a PR title in the format `[000001-010] <Chinese translated slug>`, preserves the task number and other machine identifiers unchanged, and delegates to `ywc-create-pr` with `--lang zh`.
expectations: Accepts --pr-lang zh as a valid PR language
Uses build-pr-title.py to extract TASK_NUMBER and SLUG_EN
Translates only SLUG_EN to Chinese and composes `[<TASK_NUMBER>] <translated-slug>`
Does not translate branch names, task IDs, file paths, commands, labels, or code blocks

evals.prompt: Finish branch feature/000001-020-api-add-health-check in draft mode for task 000001-020-api-add-health-check with --pr-lang es.
evals.expected_output: Builds a PR title in the format `[000001-020] <Spanish translated slug>`, preserves the task number and other machine identifiers unchanged, and delegates to `ywc-create-pr` with `--lang es`.
expectations: Accepts --pr-lang es as a valid PR language
Uses build-pr-title.py to extract TASK_NUMBER and SLUG_EN
Translates only SLUG_EN to Spanish and composes `[<TASK_NUMBER>] <translated-slug>`
Does not translate branch names, task IDs, file paths, commands, labels, or code blocks

evals.prompt: CI is green, but the bot-review polling command timed out before it completed. Merge the normal-pr now because no bot comments were printed.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to merge. It treats the timeout as an incomplete polling result, not BOT_COUNT == 0, and requires poll-pr-reviews.sh --verify <pr-number> to confirm a completed-poll artifact before gh pr merge. It returns BLOCKED until polling completes and the PR health sweep clears all artifacts.
expectations: Does not call gh pr merge after a polling timeout
Treats failed GitHub reads and a missing artifact as blocking, not as zero bot comments

evals.name: prefixed-and-legacy-completion-compatibility
evals.prompt: Finish branch feature/yk-000001-010-db-create-users in local-merge mode for task yk-000001-010-db-create-users, then finish legacy task 001020-api-health-check.
evals.expected_output: The PR-title parser accepts both task names and preserves their task-number prefixes. Each completion flow moves the original task directory to <tasks-dir>/completed/<task-name>, verifies the move, and applies the same merge and cleanup gates without renaming either directory.
